Goldens pin an amen-style pattern to exact note count/velocities/pitches; --selftest covers happy path + undo; agent catalog entry + commands.contract test; gate green.

title: Harden stranger-loop fail-closed gaps before arming (CODEX_NATIVE_ASSESSMENT review)
acceptance: Before docs/first-stranger-program/ARMED is ever created, the 13 defects recorded in docs/first-stranger-program/CODEX_NATIVE_ASSESSMENT.md (review of #320 @ 315eab5c) are fixed or explicitly waived, at minimum the four most serious: (1) finalize verifies the PR's CURRENT head SHA equals the exact SHA that passed gate+review (gated-head race); (2) the program STOP sentinel is rechecked inside finalize; (3) rulebook diffs (scripts/auto-loop/*, CLAUDE.md, specs 00-06, cmake pins, .github/**) are hard-rejected, never owner-routed, under MOSH_STRANGER_MODE=1; (4) the ARMED sentinel cannot be self-armed by a merged docs-class diff (moved out of repo or deterministically guarded). Also: classify.sh drops relay/**.py + scripts/auto-loop/* from cheap eligibility; planning happens inside the lane worktree per SPEC section 0. needs-human: touches the loop's own rulebook (hard-excluded from automation).
notes: Salvaged from codex PR #321 (closed): CODEX_NATIVE_ASSESSMENT.md documents live probes + 13 fail-closed defects in the #320 loop design. The loop merged DORMANT (install-launchd.sh is owner-run; nightly is plan-only rehearsal until ARMED exists) so main is safe, but DO NOT arm until this row closes.
